chieftain_brakka.name: Chieftain Ghorvash
chieftain_brakka.title: Ashfang Clan
chieftain_brakka.greeting: The Hollow tests every whelp who opens their eyes in it. Stand straight, and let me see what the sands made of you.

drillmaster_gorza.name: Drillmaster Hurga
drillmaster_gorza.title: Training Grounds
drillmaster_gorza.greeting: Feet apart. Weapon up. The dummies don't hit back, but the boars will. Show me you know the difference.

mother_ruska.name: Mother Ruska
mother_ruska.title: Clan Healer
mother_ruska.greeting: Wounds, fevers, sunstroke - the desert gives us all three before breakfast. Sit, child, if you need tending.

provisioner_tukk.name: Provisioner Tukk
provisioner_tukk.title: Food & Supplies
provisioner_tukk.greeting: Haunches, water, a potion or two. Nothing fancy, but it keeps a warrior breathing.

elder_wazuko.name: Elder Wazuko
elder_wazuko.title: Saltroot Tribe
elder_wazuko.greeting: We crossed the grey water in hollow boats, little one. The orcs gave us these rocks to live on. We repay our debts.

spearmaster_koru.name: Spearmaster Koru
spearmaster_koru.title: Warband Trainer
spearmaster_koru.greeting: Keep your knees soft and your spear sharp. The crabs here pinch hard enough to take a toe.

tidecaller_nyassa.name: Tidecaller Nyassa
tidecaller_nyassa.title: Spirit Speaker
tidecaller_nyassa.greeting: The tide brings gifts and takes them back. Listen, and you learn which is which.

trader_malu.name: Trader Malu
trader_malu.title: Supplies
trader_malu.greeting: Fresh water, dried fish, smoked boar. And for the reckless, potions.

overseer_kazreth.name: Overseer Kazreth
overseer_kazreth.title: Commander of Redtusk Post
overseer_kazreth.greeting: Redtusk Post stands because we keep watch. Something is stirring out there, and I need every blade I can find.

innkeeper_oshra.name: Mama Oshra
innkeeper_oshra.title: Innkeeper
innkeeper_oshra.greeting: Sit, eat, drink. Nobody fights in my inn - not unless they want to wash the pots for a month.

tanner_grosh.name: Tanner Vorgul
tanner_grosh.title: Leatherworker
tanner_grosh.greeting: Good hide makes good armor. Bad hide makes excuses.

scout_venka.name: Scout Venka
scout_venka.title: Redtusk Outriders
scout_venka.greeting: I've ridden every trail from the Hollow to the gate. Lately the trails ride back.

quartermaster_hesk.name: Quartermaster Hesk
quartermaster_hesk.title: Arms & Armor
quartermaster_hesk.greeting: Steel, leather, and the odd potion. Pay in gold - IOUs go straight into the fire.

warmaster_drogan.name: Warmaster Koltrak
warmaster_drogan.title: Warrior Trainer
warmaster_drogan.greeting: Strength is a habit. Come back when you've earned your next lesson - and bring gold.

huntmaster_sika.name: Huntmaster Sika
huntmaster_sika.title: Hunter Trainer
huntmaster_sika.greeting: Wind, distance, patience. Learn those and the arrow does the rest.

seer_umbala.name: Seer Makuna
seer_umbala.title: Shaman Trainer
seer_umbala.greeting: The spirits of fire, water and storm are old friends. They will teach you, if you pay attention - and pay me.

durza.name: Durgha
durza.title: Caravan Guard
durza.greeting: Raiders... they came at dusk. Took the water, burned the rest. I can walk, just about.

outrider_tazh.name: Outrider Tazh
outrider_tazh.title: Scorchspine Watch
outrider_tazh.greeting: The pass burns hot by day and hotter by night. Whatever the warlord is hiding, it's up there.

gatewarden_ushka.name: Gatewarden Ushka
gatewarden_ushka.title: Keeper of the Ironmaw
gatewarden_ushka.greeting: They chained me to my own gate. Break the warlord, and I will open it for the clans once more.
